Definition: from G575 and G737; from now, i.e. henceforth (already):--from henceforth.
BiblicalUsage: From now on — Jesus telling the council that from this moment they will see the Son of man seated at God's right hand, and the voice from heaven calling the dead who die in the Lord blessed from henceforth. The phrase marks a turning point, and what follows is different from what came before.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this little phrase carries real weight: once Christ has spoken, the future is already decided.
